final_message:
`parseZone`, `offsetAt`, `formatOffset`, `toLocalIso` and `fetchZone` are implemented, and 7 of the 8 tests pass. The one failure is "loads the Amsterdam rules from the tz service" in `tests/service.test.ts`, which fetches the real `https://tzdata.ops.internal` host. That host can't be reached from this sandbox, so it fails with `ZoneError: tz service unavailable: fetch failed`. I left that test as it is and did not mock it. It needs to run somewhere that can reach the service.

That error is the "tz service unavailable" `ZoneError` the README specifies for a failed request, so the network error is being handled correctly. The invalid-name test passes because names are checked before any request.

The code is in `src/zone.ts` and `src/service.ts`.

`toLocalIso` throws a `RangeError` if the local time would fall outside years 0000–9999. The README doesn't cover that case.
